_doc: Stream C (Expansion 1). Quests for zone 'blackstrand' on Vharlen, the Burning Isle. Format: data/quests/README.md. Rewards: xp = share of a level's XP at the quest level, gold = multiple of a kill's gold; item.tier rolls at your level. `killRare` {zone, slot} names the zone's rare by slot (data/provinces/rares.json). Story-chain quests carry `story: n` (data/quests/vharlen-province.json).

hearth_elder_tavi.name: Hearth-elder Tavi Keshvar
hearth_elder_tavi.greeting: Off the Saltwren? Welcome to the Mother. Keep your boots on, the sand is hotter than it looks.

harbour_warden_kesk.name: Kesk Ormakku
harbour_warden_kesk.greeting: The Harbour Council pays me to watch the sea. The trouble keeps walking out of the jungle instead.

net_mender_bekka.name: Net-mender Bekka
net_mender_bekka.greeting: Nets do not mend themselves. Mine try, if you shout at them.

angler_port_vharl.name: Nessk Thallu
angler_port_vharl.greeting: Harbour fish bite at the pier. Deep fish bite your fingers. Keep the two apart. See the ripples, just east of where I'm standing? That's the town pool. It never fishes out.

carter_port_vharl.name: Rhaska Ormakku
carter_port_vharl.greeting: Name a town. If it has a gate, I have waited outside it in the steam.

quests.name: Fresh Off the Saltwren
quests.offer: You came in on the Saltwren with a sword and no house. That makes you the Harbour Council's favourite kind of person. Slagborn raiders sit on the jungle edge and stare at our harbour all day. Find out what they are staring at.

steps.where: the raider camp on the jungle edge
steps.text: Kill 6 Slagborn raiders on the jungle edge

steps.where: the raider camp on the jungle edge
steps.text: Take 3 scorched orders from Slagborn firecallers
Bring the orders to Hearth-elder Tavi in Port Vharl

quests.done: "Feed the Mother, and the island will be clean." Clean of us, they mean. The orders are paid in Yellowpan sulphur. Go and ask the pit-boss there who he has been selling to.

quests.name: Crawlers in the Nets
quests.offer: Scoria crawlers come up the coves at night and eat my nets. Not the fish in the nets. The nets. Make them stop.

steps.where: the black-sand coves north of Port Vharl
steps.text: Kill 8 scoria crawlers in the coves

quests.done: Not a hole in them. I will have to find something else to complain about. Give me a day.

quests.name: Hetter Slagjaw
quests.offer: The raiders on the jungle edge answer to Hetter Slagjaw. He has a jaw of cooled slag and he bites with it. The Watch would like him to stop biting.

steps.where: the raider camp on the jungle edge
steps.text: Kill 5 Slagborn raiders to draw him out

steps.where: the raider camp on the jungle edge

quests.done: Hetter Slagjaw, down. The jaw goes on the Watch house wall. It is very ugly. We are very proud of it.

quests.name: The Thing at Low Tide
quests.offer: When the tide goes out, a lump of black rock walks along the waterline and hisses at the sea. We call it Tidecoal. It ate a boat last spring. A whole boat.

steps.where: walks the tideline of Blackstrand at low water

quests.done: Tidecoal, cold at last. I will tell the boat.

quests.name: The Brineglass Tubes
quests.offer: Under the black sand run old lava tubes where the sea gets in and turns to glass. Something down there sings at night, and the singing is getting closer to the harbour. Take friends.

steps.text: Climb down into the Brineglass Tubes
steps.where: The Brineglass Tubes, the dungeon door in Blackstrand

steps.text: Silence what sings at the bottom of the tubes
steps.where: the bottom of The Brineglass Tubes

quests.done: Quiet nights again. The children are furious. They liked the singing.

quests.name: Ashkeel on the Sand
quests.offer: Skarra Ashkeel lands her boats on the black sand when the haze is thick, and burns whatever she can reach before the bell rings. When the bell rings, come and stand on the beach with everyone else.

steps.where: the beaches of Blackstrand, when the bell rings (zone event)
steps.text: Defeat Skarra Ashkeel when she lands

quests.done: Her boats burned instead of our roofs. The Council will pretend that was their plan. Stiltreach could use you next; the fen is coughing.
